name: @openfair/sdk
description: openfair launchpad SDK – quotes, simulation, staged token launches, token registry and referral revenue on Robinhood Chain.

scripts.build: esbuild sdk/npm.ts --bundle --ignore-annotations --format=esm --external:viem --target=es2020 --tsconfig=tsconfig.esbuild.json --outfile=dist/index.mjs && esbuild sdk/npm.ts --bundle --ignore-annotations --format=cjs --external:viem --target=es2020 --tsconfig=tsconfig.esbuild.json --outfile=dist/index.cjs && esbuild sdk/widget.ts --bundle --ignore-annotations --format=esm --external:viem --target=es2020 --tsconfig=tsconfig.esbuild.json --outfile=dist/widget.mjs && esbuild sdk/widget.ts --bundle --ignore-annotations --format=cjs --external:viem --target=es2020 --tsconfig=tsconfig.esbuild.json --outfile=dist/widget.cjs && tsc -p tsconfig.json
